DK28.4 is a medical diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastrointestinal ulcer with bleeding. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality development, specifically within the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), this code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment outcomes. It is utilized as part of a broader set of diagnostic codes to measure the incidence of severe bleeding among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1].

The tracking of severe bleeding is a key quality indicator for atrial fibrillation management, given the widespread use of anticoagulant medications in this patient population. To capture these adverse events accurately, the database employs a comprehensive range of ICD-10-DK codes. DK28.4 is grouped alongside other gastrointestinal bleeding codes, such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]], as well as codes for intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) and urinary or respiratory bleeding (e.g., [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. This systematic methodology, documented in the annual reports from the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), ensures standardized data collection and enables cross-regional comparisons of clinical quality and patient safety in cardiovascular care [^src2].
